'File Name: mainnet/contracts/market/v0-4-market.clar -> Scope: Critical. ONE BORROWER CAN LOCK EVERY SUPPLIER OUT. `redeem` requires `(>= available-assets inkind)` where `get-available-assets` reads real liquidity, while `system-borrow` only requires `(<= amount available-assets)` and `(<= (+ debt amount) CAP-DEBT)`. Show a borrow sized to leave the vault unable to service redemptions, held open at a cost the attacker can bear because the interest curve at that utilization is mispriced or because the position is self-funded, and quantify how long suppliers are locked out. Impact: temporary freezing of funds, escalating to permanent if the position cannot be liquidated.'
